description: Evidence-linked active and historical research programs across the T81 Foundation platform

programs.name: Scientific Continuity Governance (SCG-01 through SCG-08)
programs.summary: Formal defect identification, mathematical isolation, multi-phase repair, and qualification of balanced ternary arithmetic primitives.

phases.title: T81Int Convolution Multiplication & Assert Hardening
phases.details: Repairs C05 (2N-trit convolution with overflow trap) and C11 (fail-closed assert to require hardening active under NDEBUG).

phases.title: Maintainer Decision Record for Foundation Contracts
phases.details: D1=1B (dual-surface arithmetic), D2=2B (RFC-00D5 checked conversion profile), D3=3B (versioned ISA profiles), D4=4B (generic Result<T,E>). Implementation strictly not authorized.

phases.title: Generic Result<T,E> Feasibility Audit
phases.details: Read-only feasibility study establishing Result<T,E> boundaries without modifying production code or normative specs.

phases.title: Arithmetic Defect Reproduction Audit (F1-F7)
phases.details: Independent reproduction of Issue #717 findings across pre/post-repair baselines: F1 confirmed unchanged, F2 confirmed unchanged, F3 confirmed unchanged, F4 confirmed fixed, F5 confirmed unchanged, F6 confirmed failure-mode change, F7 confirmed unchanged.

phases.title: Phase 1: T81Fraction Exception & Conversion Hardening (F6/F7)
phases.details: Removes noexcept from throwing fraction operators; replaces to_int64 in to_double with safe accumulator.

phases.title: Phase 2: T81BigInt Borrow & Sign Invariant Repair (F5)
phases.details: Repairs single-limb fallback in operator+ ensuring stored limbs remain non-negative in magnitude.

phases.title: Phase 3: T81Limb27 Booth Table Scaling Elimination (F1)
phases.details: Replaces defective Booth27 table accumulation with direct balanced ternary multiply-accumulate and exact normalization.

phases.title: Phase 4: T81Limb54 Reference Multiplication Normalization (F2)
phases.details: Replaces flawed single-step subtraction carry loop with exact balanced-ternary carry normalization across 54-trit domain.

phases.title: Phase 5: T81Limb54 Karatsuba Carry-Loss Invariance (F3)
phases.details: Mathematical proof that intermediate 28th-trit carry discard scales by 3^27 and is congruent to 0 mod 3^54. Historical causal attribution incomplete.

phases.title: Phase 6: Consolidated Arithmetic Qualification
phases.details: Executive disposition: QUALIFIED WITH LIMITATIONS. All F1-F7 reproducers pass unconditionally against ExactBigIntOracle. F3 qualified under modular residue contract.

phases.title: Phase 0: Architectural Advantage Research Charter
phases.details: Mathematical derivation of 3-state carry Markov chain; finite-N carry expectation formulas; preregistration of candidate experiment EXP-SCG08-01.

phases.title: Phase 1: Contract Reconciliation (Signed-Domain & Cost Metric)
phases.details: Addenda 01-05 standardize on signed B-bit operand domain [-2^(B-1), 2^(B-1)-1]; Gate 1 implementation authorization and Gate 2 execution remain strictly withheld.

programs.name: TernaryOS Operating System & ARCH-ENG-002 Diagnostics
programs.summary: Freestanding AArch64 bare-metal kernel development, UEFI firmware payload investigation, and fail-closed QEMU verification harness repair.

phases.title: Phase 1: Architecture Drift & Harness Defect Audit
phases.details: Deterministic drift detection; mandatory component evidence index; documented ((COMPLETED_TESTS++)) defect under set -e.

phases.title: Phase 2: Fail-Closed QEMU Verification Harness Repair
phases.details: Consolidated nonasserting shell orchestration into bounded Python QMP verifier; eliminates false positives; 11/11 mock tests pass; real QEMU halts and safely rejects failed boots.

phases.title: Phase 3: UEFI Payload & Firmware Investigation
phases.details: Identified two distinct barriers: (1) verifier stops at firmware diagnostics before testing guest readiness; (2) tracked payload is a historical 5,120-byte probe WFI loop, while freshly compiled 75,264-byte EFI reaches real shell and replies to help. Native 5-check verification remains NOT QUALIFIED.

phases.title: TISC v1.1.0 Capability Freeze Integrity
phases.details: Enforces 209 opcodes, reserved range cleanliness (174..255), and bitwise operation invariants.

phases.title: Freestanding AArch64 Cross-Profile Execution
phases.details: Demonstrated bounded execution of canonical 351-byte program across hosted T81VM and freestanding AArch64 QEMU matching mathematical oracle across 25 observation boundaries.

phases.title: Bounded Cross-Profile Conformance Suite
phases.details: 19/19 frozen-oracle cases across 57 hosted and 57 fresh AArch64 QEMU executions.

phases.title: Versioned TISC State Transition Contract (RFC-00D6)
phases.details: Decision matrix addressing memory operands, branch semantics, TXor truth table, and atomic trap progression.

phases.title: CanonFS Block Metadata Authorization

phases.title: Correctness & Retention Boundary Enforcement

hypothesis_mappings.title: Balanced Ternary Elementary Representation Advantage
hypothesis_mappings.governance_note: Scalar tryte addition in software incurs 10.6x instruction overhead compared to native 64-bit Boolean addition. Closed for scalar software; multi-precision re-evaluated in SCG-08.

hypothesis_mappings.title: Multi-Precision Software Addition Carry Advantage
hypothesis_mappings.governance_note: Carry Markov chain proves 1/4 stationary non-zero occurrence vs 1/2 in binary. Tier 2 operation-count benchmark preregistered in SCG-08 Phase 0; Gate 1/2 authorization withheld.

hypothesis_mappings.title: TISC vs Wasm Artifact Density Advantage
hypothesis_mappings.governance_note: Artifact size comparisons depend heavily on encoding format. No independent cross-compiler density advantage established.

hypothesis_mappings.title: Dynamic Precision Adaptation Advantage
hypothesis_mappings.governance_note: H04-R03 Candidate A correctness and retention verified; Phase C performance benchmarks frozen.

hypothesis_mappings.title: Three-State Circuit Cost Reduction vs Boolean
hypothesis_mappings.governance_note: RTL models signed two-bit signals; Boolean synthesis comparison under common process remains unperformed.

hypothesis_mappings.title: Ternary Weights / Activations Inference Advantage
hypothesis_mappings.governance_note: No inference benchmark, model accuracy, or device energy independently reproduced. Prior claims classified as unverified.

hypothesis_mappings.title: Governed Execution Auditability Advantage
hypothesis_mappings.governance_note: Axion policy engine and nondeterminism detection active; security certification requires independent protocol completion.

hypothesis_mappings.title: AI-Assisted Research Trustworthiness & Discovery
hypothesis_mappings.governance_note: Audited via continuous session handoffs, negative result preservation, and mathematical oracle qualification.
